[taste_coherence] Store-bought hummus is usually already quite acidic and well-seasoned. Drizzling a full 1/2 tbsp of raw lemon juice over a small 1.5 oz portion of hummus may make it too tart and watery. Consider omitting the lemon juice and simply pressing the za'atar and hemp hearts directly into the hummus.

details.summary: A fresh, appealing, and thoroughly Mediterranean snack plate that hits the right qualitative marks for the diet. However, the current portion sizes slightly overshoot the strict carbohydrate, calorie, and sodium ceilings for the snack tier; reducing the crispbread portion will bring it comfortably into compliance.

The recipe slightly overshoots the snack tier's strict ceilings for carbohydrates (27.2 g vs 24 g limit), calories (235 vs 230 limit), and sodium. To fix this, reduce the whole-grain crispbreads from 4 slices (36 g) to 2 slices (18 g) total (meaning 1 large slice per person). This will drop the carbs to ~14 g and calories to ~170, neatly centering the dish in the snack window.
Easily assembled from a cold start in 10 minutes using standard, accessible supermarket ingredients.
